vision: The pilgrimage becomes a complete adventure loop instead of ending abruptly at sanctum attunement: after the finale, the world enters an unstable epilogue and the player must race back to a return shrine at spawn, with clear reverse-route guidance, urgent feedback, and deterministic bridge-visible completion telemetry.
objectives: Add a post-finale return objective (sanctum -> spawn shrine) so progression continues after finale_completed and culminates in a true cycle-complete moment.
Introduce timed epilogue pressure with readable urgency cues (HUD + world feedback) that make the return leg feel intentional without introducing random failure noise.
Extend objective/bridge payloads with additive epilogue fields (remaining time, return objective state, cycle completion state) while preserving existing keys for compatibility.
Upgrade pilgrimage playtest behavior to finish the new return leg and fail loudly on return-timeout or missing cycle-complete events.
Validate deterministic completion across multi-seed runs (including screenshot-enabled mode) with startup stall metric still at zero and cycle-complete observed in logs/events.
implementationHints: Treat this as one cohesive pacing/story-progression pass: finale should trigger epilogue immediately, not a disconnected side system.
Keep new objective snapshot fields additive so existing OBS consumers remain backward compatible.
Reuse existing route-guidance infrastructure by adding a reverse leg for sanctum-to-spawn instead of building a parallel guidance stack.
implementationDetails: In src/main.js, extend quest state machine with explicit epilogue-return stages (e.g., return_active / return_failed / cycle_completed) and keep finale_completed as a milestone event rather than terminal end-of-run.

Author a new return shrine objective at/near spawn (perceivable + interactable + collider + visual identity) and wire it into objective sequencing so sanctum attunement transitions to return objective_started.

Add deterministic return timer runtime (e.g., configurable budget seconds) that starts at epilogue begin; surface remaining time in HUD text and objective snapshot; emit warning events at meaningful thresholds (for example <=10s).

If timer expires before return attunement, emit explicit return_failed telemetry + player-facing feedback and reset/soft-fail state deterministically (no hangs). If return attunes in time, emit return_completed + pilgrimage_cycle_completed telemetry.

Extend route guidance to support active reverse leg from sanctum_core to return shrine (distinct color treatment from outbound guidance) and ensure routeHint* fields continue updating throughout epilogue.

Update objective snapshot payload with additive fields such as epilogueActive, returnObjectiveId, returnTimeBudgetSec, returnTimeRemainingSec, returnFailed, and cycleCompleted; preserve existing guidance/approach fields.

Update scripts/playtest-beacon-pilgrimage.mjs to continue beyond finale into the return objective, assert cycle-complete success, and fail on return timeout or missing return_completed/pilgrimage_cycle_completed events within RUN_SEC.

Add/record return-leg pacing metrics in logs (for example returnSplitSec and totalCycleSec) plus existing lockToAttune/startup metrics; keep lock_to_attune threshold protections in place for every attunement objective including return shrine if lock-gated.

Validation before handoff: npm run build; run seeded pilgrimage+return suite (ROAM_SEED=404, 505, 606) using AGENT_SCRIPT=scripts/playtest-beacon-pilgrimage.mjs; run one screenshot-enabled seed on isolated DEV_PORT/BRIDGE_PORT and verify non-blank before/after captures.

Record evidence in sim/cycles/<cycleId>/exec_result.json and playtest_handoff.txt: exact commands, return timer behavior, return/cycle completion events, pacing metrics, and screenshot paths showing epilogue readability.
